LanguageData.IRBM_BasicRocketry.label: basic rocketry
LanguageData.IRBM_BasicRocketry.description: Master the fundamentals of liquid and solid fuel propulsion to build early missile launch platforms.
LanguageData.IRBM_EarlyWarheads.label: early warheads
LanguageData.IRBM_EarlyWarheads.description: Repurpose standard mortar shells into specialized missile payloads for tactical strikes.
LanguageData.IRBM_EarlyDelivery.label: early delivery vehicles
LanguageData.IRBM_EarlyDelivery.description: Develop early missile bodies like the Redstone and Tomahawk for short-to-medium range delivery.
LanguageData.IRBM_EarlyWarning.label: doppler surveillance
LanguageData.IRBM_EarlyWarning.description: Utilize Doppler radar technology to detect high-speed suborbital objects entering local airspace.
LanguageData.IRBM_AdvancedAerospace.label: advanced aerospace
LanguageData.IRBM_AdvancedAerospace.description: Refine propulsion and hull materials to support larger payloads and orbital capabilities.
LanguageData.IRBM_OrbitalRecon.label: orbital reconnaissance
LanguageData.IRBM_OrbitalRecon.description: Launch specialized satellites into orbit to provide persistent observation of the world map.
LanguageData.IRBM_NuclearDeterrence.label: strategic deterrence
LanguageData.IRBM_NuclearDeterrence.description: Develop massive multi-stage rockets and heavy nuclear payloads to ensure total map annihilation.
LanguageData.IRBM_KineticInterception.label: kinetic interception
LanguageData.IRBM_KineticInterception.description: Combine high-speed computation with rapid-fire cannons or agile missiles to intercept hostile projectiles.
LanguageData.IRBM_PrecisionPropulsion.label: precision propulsion
LanguageData.IRBM_PrecisionPropulsion.description: Implement ultra-tech guidance systems and multi-pulse engines for superior range and accuracy.
LanguageData.IRBM_SpecializedPayloads.label: specialized payloads
LanguageData.IRBM_SpecializedPayloads.description: Create advanced tactical warheads utilizing chemical, electromagnetic, and miniature nuclear reactions.
LanguageData.IRBM_HypersonicResearch.label: hypersonic flight
LanguageData.IRBM_HypersonicResearch.description: Study high-speed atmospheric gliding to develop missiles that are extremely hard to intercept.
LanguageData.IRBM_AdvancedInterception.label: advanced interception
LanguageData.IRBM_AdvancedInterception.description: Use phased-array radar and directed energy weapons for higher interception rates and more reliable defense.
LanguageData.IRBM_VacuumEnergy.label: vacuum energy
LanguageData.IRBM_VacuumEnergy.description: Harness fundamental physical constants to achieve near-instantaneous delivery and absolute destruction.
LanguageData.IRBM_OrbitalStrike.label: orbital strike
LanguageData.IRBM_OrbitalStrike.description: Master the technology to coordinate precision strikes from orbital platforms, enabling the deployment of offensive satellite payloads.
LanguageData.IRBM_AtomicAnnihilation.label: atomic annihilation
LanguageData.IRBM_AtomicAnnihilation.description: Develop warheads that use antimatter or advanced shielding to bypass political consequences and physical defenses.
LanguageData.IRBM_BunkerBusterTech.label: crust penetration
LanguageData.IRBM_BunkerBusterTech.description: Combine molecular drills with heavy penetrators to strike targets deep beneath the surface.
LanguageData.IRBM_UltimateDelivery.label: ultimate delivery platforms
LanguageData.IRBM_UltimateDelivery.description: Unlock the final generation of missile bodies, including hypersonic glide vehicles and heavy strategic carriers.
LanguageData.IRBM_WeatherControl.label: weather control
LanguageData.IRBM_WeatherControl.description: Master the art of precise atmospheric intervention. By dispersing specialized nucleation catalysts or stimulating high-altitude atmospheric energy, immediate reshaping of local climates can be achieved.
LanguageData.IRBM_ZeroPointCollapse.label: zero-point collapse
LanguageData.IRBM_ZeroPointCollapse.description: The ultimate weapon. Create a controlled singularity that swallows maps without a trace. Requires persona core regulation.
LanguageData.IRBM_HeisenbergAnalysis.label: Quantum signal analysis
LanguageData.IRBM_HeisenbergAnalysis.description: Try to receive mysterious quantum entangled signals from another dimension. A dormant, automated global defense system may prevent you from accessing this information.
LanguageData.IRBM_QuantumEntanglement.label: quantum entanglement projection
LanguageData.IRBM_QuantumEntanglement.description: A mysterious, god-like technology derived from high-dimensional space. By utilizing quantum entanglement properties, physical matter can be projected instantaneously. This technology is encoded within a hidden signal and cannot be researched through conventional means.
